name: When do kitchen countertops need to be replaced instead of repaired?

mainEntity.name: When do kitchen countertops need to be replaced instead of repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need replacement when you notice structural damage like unrepairable cracks, deep staining that resists restoration, or significant water damage in substrate materials. Countertop replacement is also necessary when reconfiguring your kitchen layout, changing sink styles from drop-in to undermount, or updating outdated materials to improve durability and home value. If minor chips or dull spots exist on natural stone, surface polishing can often resolve them without full replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace counters if you have large structural cracks, persistent moisture rot underneath, a changed kitchen layout, or surfaces that cannot be resurfaced or sealed.
